# `kernel/arch/sparc/sunos` — architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — sparc/sunos

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — sparc/sunos.

`config.mk` records 5 source file(s) here: `sun_disklabel.c`, `sun_ioctl.c`, `sun_misc.c`, `sun_syscalls.c`, `sun_sysent.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含4.5BSD 内核的机器相关代码 — sparc/sunos。
